nodes.text: Greetings consul. It seems as though you have not yet found a solution to settling our accounts.
nodes.speaker: Lucius

sequence.text: I know that the other ministers have their own ideas, but being head of the treasury, I would like to think that I have the most simple and effective solution.

choices.text: [RATIO] Very few things in government are simple and effective without having some drawbacks. Be honest with me.
You've got my attention. What do you suggest?

nodes.text: Well sir, that is true... Unfortunatly, this solution may not be popular among the people. However, it will generate a lot of revenue.
nodes.speaker: Lucius

choices.text: Well, let's hear your proposal anyway.
[IMPERIUM] Then is it truly an effective solution? You know we can't afford to get on the people's bad side at a time like this.

nodes.text: I suggest we raise taxes, consul. Our treasury is too far depleted not to. Other solutions may raise some funds, but they will only be temporary solitions. The people will understand that it is necessary.
nodes.speaker: Lucius

choices.text: [PROVIDENTIA] I don't think this is a good idea. The previous administration was very corrupt, and I fear the people may think that we are stealing more of their money.
[ELOQUENTIA] Let's go through with it. I think we can make that work, but I will need to give an address to the nation and win over the people's hearts and minds on this issue.

nodes.text: Very well, consul. I trust that you will find another source of revenue. But be warned, if this matter goes unresolved, Concordia will not survive.
nodes.speaker: Lucius

choices.text: I understand. I will figure something out.
